author: scrum-master-agent
estimation_method: Sub-task split 70% Dev / 20% QA / 10% Review of parent story points, each rounded to nearest Fibonacci value {1,2,3,5,8,13}; tolerance +/-1 SP versus parent per scrum-framework-core Operating Rule 14.

sprint_1_stories.title: Memory Orchestrator core facade and unified context-assembly API

invest.independent: Delivers the routing facade as its own deployable surface; other Sprint 1 zone stories register against it but it does not require any zone to exist first.
invest.negotiable: Concrete routing algorithm (e.g. rule table vs. capability registry) is an implementation choice within the Facade pattern locked by HLD Section 2.
invest.valuable: Gives the host AI system the single unified API that is the product's core integration contract (HLD Section 3.1).
invest.estimable: Facade pattern and API surface are fully specified in HLD Section 3.1 / Section 2 Container Architecture.
invest.small: Scoped to routing + API surface only; zone-internal logic is out of scope for this story.

sprint_1_stories.persona: Host AI system integrator embedding Dashanan as a library or sidecar

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a host calls the unified context-assembly API, When the request does not name any individual zone, Then the Orchestrator resolves and returns assembled context sourced from the correct zones without the host needing zone-level knowledge.

Given the Orchestrator is called before any zone story lands, When a routing request targets an unimplemented zone, Then the facade returns a typed 'zone not available' response rather than an unhandled error, so later zone stories can register without a facade contract change.

sub_tasks.description: Implement Facade routing table, ZoneRepository port wiring, and unified context-assembly endpoint.
Contract tests for AC-009 across zone-present and zone-absent routing paths.
Peer review of Facade pattern conformance against HLD Section 2/3.1.

sprint_1_stories.title: Working Memory zone (Zone 1) - TTL-primary scratch context

invest.independent: Self-contained zone with its own storage adapter; only needs the Orchestrator facade to be routable.
invest.negotiable: Concrete backend (in-process LRU vs. Redis, ADR-005) is deployment-profile-specific.
invest.valuable: Highest single-item WSJF (8.33) in the corrected 12-FR table; the zone nothing else can function without.
invest.estimable: TTL-primary eviction mechanism is fully specified (OAQ-7 adopted).

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a host session writes to Working Memory, When the item's TTL expires without promotion, Then the item is evicted from Zone 1 without requiring an explicit delete call, and no other zone is mutated as a side effect.

sub_tasks.description: Implement Zone 1 storage adapter (ADR-005), TTL-primary eviction, and write path via ZoneRepository port.
TTL-expiry-without-side-effect test per AC-001, including no-mutation-of-other-zones assertion.
Review TTL eviction correctness and adapter port compliance.

sprint_1_stories.title: Episodic Memory zone (Zone 2) - chronological recency store

invest.independent: Self-contained zone with its own storage adapter and recency index.
invest.negotiable: Concrete decay function implementation is deployment-tunable within the locked half-life defaults.
invest.valuable: WSJF rank 3 (6.00) - Performance-classified requirement the product depends on for time-anchored recall.
invest.estimable: Recency ordering and per-entry decay attribute are fully specified.
invest.small: Scoped to Zone 2 write/query-by-recency only; capacity cap is split into its own story (DASH-STORY-004).

acceptance_criteria.text: Given multiple Episodic entries with distinct timestamps, When the host queries Zone 2 by recency, Then results are returned in strict chronological order and each entry exposes its own decay attribute.

sub_tasks.description: Implement Zone 2 chronological store, recency query path, per-entry decay attribute.
Strict-chronological-order and decay-attribute-exposure test per AC-002.
Review recency query correctness and decay attribute schema.

sprint_1_stories.title: Zone 2 capacity cap and MaxAge forced-archival backstop (OAQ-4)

invest.independent: A bounded add-on to Zone 2's storage layer; does not require FR-012's full rotation state machine to exist, only a capacity/age check on write.
invest.negotiable: Exact cap value and MaxAge threshold are operator-configurable (NFR-009).
invest.valuable: HLD Section 12F names this the only mechanism preventing unbounded Zone 2 growth in a sprint with no Archived destination (Zone 8 out of scope) - a hard Sprint 1 dependency, not optional.
invest.estimable: OAQ-4 defines the mechanism: per-zone capacity cap + MaxAge forced archival, converting Memory Score into a ranking function with a threshold fast-path.
invest.small: Scoped to Zone 2 only for Sprint 1 (per-zone generalization to other zones is out of Sprint 1 scope).
invest.testable: New AC below, since OAQ-4 is a HLD-derived requirement not yet in the SRS ACs.

sprint_1_stories.persona: Platform operator running Dashanan without Zone 8 available

acceptance_criteria.text: Given Zone 2 reaches its configured capacity cap or an item exceeds its configured MaxAge while in the Compressed state, When the capacity/age backstop sweep runs, Then the lowest-ranked-by-MemoryScore item(s) are forcibly evicted from Zone 2 so the zone never grows unbounded, even though no Archived destination exists in Sprint 1.
acceptance_criteria.source: [DERIVED FROM HLD Section 12F / OAQ-4 - explicit Sprint 1 dependency, not silently deferred]

acceptance_criteria.text: Given the capacity cap and MaxAge values are deployment configuration (NFR-009), When an operator changes either value, Then the backstop sweep uses the new values on its next run without a code change.

sub_tasks.description: Implement capacity-cap + MaxAge forced-eviction sweep for Zone 2, configurable per NFR-009.
Test capacity-cap trigger, MaxAge trigger, and lowest-MemoryScore eviction ordering.
Review that this backstop is documented as a Sprint 1 hard dependency (HLD Section 12F), not an optional nice-to-have.

sprint_1_stories.sub_task_sp_note: Sum 4 vs parent 3 - within +/-1 Fibonacci-rounding tolerance per scrum-framework-core Operating Rule 14.

sprint_1_stories.title: Provenance/Audit zone (Zone 7) - source, confidence, edit history

invest.independent: Self-contained append-only zone; depends only on Zone 1 existing first per the promoted dependency graph.
invest.negotiable: Concrete hash-chain implementation (SHA-256 prev_hash) is an ADR-locked but internally swappable detail.
invest.valuable: WSJF rank 5 (4.80) and the strongest single memory-poisoning control (HLD T-1) - the audit chain every other zone's writes depend on.
invest.estimable: Append-only, no-UPDATE-grant, source/confidence/edit-history schema is fully specified in HLD ADR-010.
invest.small: Scoped to the Zone 7 store and its query path; the cross-cutting write-path enforcement is its own story (DASH-STORY-006).

acceptance_criteria.text: Given any fact is written to any zone, When the Provenance/Audit zone is queried for that fact's item_id, Then a source attribution, confidence score, and edit history entry exists and is retrievable.

sub_tasks.description: Implement append-only Zone 7 store, SHA-256 prev_hash chain, source/confidence/edit-history schema, no-UPDATE role enforcement.
Test retrievability by item_id and append-only/no-UPDATE enforcement per AC-007 and HLD T-2.
Review hash-chain tamper-detectability and DB role least-privilege.

invest.independent: A gate on the Orchestrator's existing write path; testable independently of any single zone's internal logic.
invest.negotiable: Synchronous-vs-WAL/outbox-relayed enforcement mechanism is an ADR-010 implementation choice (OAQ-8), while the guarantee itself is fixed.
invest.valuable: WSJF rank 2 (6.25), Must-Be Kano - the PRD's stated enforcement mechanism for the product's entire anti-hallucination thesis.
invest.estimable: 422-rejection contract and WAL/outbox durability barrier are fully specified in HLD Section 7.2 / Section 8.4 / ADR-010.
invest.small: Scoped to the write-path gate only; does not re-implement Zone 7 itself.
invest.testable: AC-010 and AC-016 give concrete Given-When-Thens.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a write request to any zone omits a resolvable source_type, When the Orchestrator's write path processes it, Then the write is rejected (HTTP 422) and no fact is persisted without a corresponding Provenance/Audit entry, consistent with the WAL/outbox durability barrier.
Given a zone write bypasses provenance recording, When the write path is exercised, Then the write is rejected before persistence (same enforcement path as AC-010).

sub_tasks.description: Implement WAL/outbox write-path gate on the Orchestrator (FR-009), 422 rejection on unresolvable source_type.
Test rejection-before-persistence for missing/unresolvable source_type per AC-010/AC-016, across all Sprint 1 zones.
Review that the gate is structurally unbypassable (HLD's stated design intent) rather than a per-call convention.

sprint_1_stories.title: Retrieval-Index zone (Zone 6) - hybrid vector + lexical index

invest.independent: Self-contained index zone; depends only on Zone 1 existing first per the promoted dependency graph, and indexes whichever zones exist (Zones 1, 2, 7 in Sprint 1).
invest.negotiable: Concrete fusion algorithm (RRF for ranking) is swappable within the vector+lexical architecture (ADR-007, ADR-008).
invest.valuable: WSJF rank 6 (tied, 4.60) - supplies the TaskRelevance/UserAffinity primitives every Memory Score computation needs (FR-012).
invest.estimable: Fused vector+lexical index and per-tenant physical partitioning are fully specified in HLD ADR-007/ADR-008.
invest.small: Scoped to the index and its similarity primitives; the Memory Score computation itself is a separate story (DASH-STORY-008).
invest.testable: AC-006 and AC-014 give concrete Given-When-Thens.

sprint_1_stories.persona: Host AI system context-assembly caller needing task-relevant recall

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an item exists in any of Zones 1-5, 7, 8, When the Retrieval-Index is queried with a task-relevant query, Then the vector + lexical fused result includes that item within the top-k candidates used to compute TaskRelevance for the Memory Score.

Given two tenants A and B each store semantically similar content, When tenant A performs a retrieval query, Then the Retrieval-Index returns results only from tenant A's physically partitioned vector/lexical collection, UserAffinity never acts as a tenant-isolation term, and no shared cache key leaks a hit/miss signal about tenant B's content.

sub_tasks.description: Implement per-tenant physically-partitioned vector + lexical index, RRF-based ranking fusion, tenant_id-prefixed cache keys.
Test top-k inclusion per AC-006, and cross-tenant isolation (physical partition + no cache-oracle leak) per AC-014.
Security review of tenant isolation controls (HLD I-1/I-2/I-3, ADR-007/ADR-013).

invest.independent: A computation service consuming inputs from Zones 6 and 7; does not itself own storage.
invest.negotiable: Default weight profile (1/6 each) is operator-overridable per NFR-009; the term formula itself is locked.
invest.valuable: WSJF rank 6 (tied, 4.60) - the scoring backbone every rotation and read-filter decision depends on.
invest.estimable: MemoryScore = w1*Recency + w2*Frequency + w3*Importance + w4*UserAffinity + w5*TaskRelevance + w6*ProvenanceConfidence is fully specified in FR-012 and HLD Section 3.1/12A-12C.
invest.small: Scoped to score computation only; the rotation state machine that consumes the score is a separate story (DASH-STORY-009).
invest.testable: AC-012 and AC-017 give concrete Given-When-Thens; Importance defaulting is a named HLD gap made explicit here.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given a deployment operator sets a non-default weight profile (w1..w6) or rotation thresholds, When the Orchestrator computes MemoryScore for that deployment, Then the configured values are used instead of the MVP defaults, without a code change.

Given Zone 4 (Procedural) is out of Sprint 1 scope, When Importance is computed for a Sprint 1 item, Then Importance is sourced from an explicit tag only and defaults to 0.5 when no tag is present, per HLD Section 12F's stated recommendation (not silently discovered later).

sub_tasks.description: Implement six-term MemoryScore computation, per-deployment weight/threshold configuration surface (NFR-009), explicit-tag-only Importance with 0.5 default.
Test configured-weight substitution per AC-017 and Importance default-to-0.5 behavior.
Review normalization of all six terms to [0,1] and the structural score-floor implications noted in OAQ-3.

sprint_1_stories.title: Rotation state machine - Active to Compressed (Archived deferred)

invest.independent: Consumes the Memory Score engine's output; does not require Zone 8 (Archived destination) to exist, per HLD Section 12F's explicit Sprint 1 recommendation.
invest.negotiable: Deadline-scheduling implementation detail (O(k log N), Section 12C) is swappable within the state-machine contract.
invest.valuable: Completes the gated lifecycle guarantee (compression can never be skipped) that the product's memory-management promise depends on.
invest.estimable: PromoteThreshold > CompressThreshold > ArchiveThreshold gating is locked by construction (FR-012), and HLD Section 12F specifies Sprint 1 stops at Compressed.
invest.small: Scoped to Active -> Compressed only for Sprint 1; Compressed -> Archived is explicitly out of scope until the sprint that delivers Zone 8.
invest.testable: AC-012 gives a concrete Given-When-Then, scoped to the Compressed transition.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an item's MemoryScore crosses CompressThreshold but not ArchiveThreshold, When the rotation sweep runs, Then the item transitions to Compressed and remains retrievable in compressed form; it SHALL NOT be able to reach Archived without having passed through Compressed, per PromoteThreshold > CompressThreshold > ArchiveThreshold.

Given Zone 8 (Consolidation) is out of Sprint 1 scope, When an item's MemoryScore would otherwise cross ArchiveThreshold, Then the item remains in Compressed indefinitely (bounded only by DASH-STORY-004's capacity/MaxAge backstop) rather than the Orchestrator attempting an Archived transition with no destination, per HLD Section 12F.

sub_tasks.description: Implement Active -> Compressed transition with deadline-scheduled sweep (O(k log N)), gated construction preventing Archived-without-Compressed, and Compressed-indefinite-dwell behavior for Sprint 1.
Test Compress-threshold-crossing transition per AC-012 and the Compressed-indefinite-dwell behavior per AC-012-ROT-1.
Review that no code path attempts an Archived transition in Sprint 1 (Zone 8 absent) and that DASH-STORY-004's backstop is the sole bound on Compressed growth.

dependency_graph.promotion_reason: DASH-STORY-002 (Working Memory, Zone 1) is the sole root dependency for DASH-STORY-005 (Zone 7) and DASH-STORY-007 (Zone 6) per the mandated 'Zone 6/Zone 7 both depend on Zone 1 existing first' constraint. DASH-STORY-001 (Orchestrator) is the sole root dependency for all zone stories since every write/read routes through its facade.
